units.text: I have been lying under my blankets for three hours, frozen stiff in the dark.
It is five thirty in the morning, and the copper smell of blood in my bedroom is making me gag.
Across the room, my dead parents are propped upright, staring straight into my face with wide, lifeless eyes.
And right now, the thing that killed them is crouched beneath my mattress.
Let us go back to the beginning.
At two thirty in the morning, a violent scream tore through the far end of the hallway.
I woke up in a cold sweat, sitting upright with my heart hammering.
Before investigating, I stopped in the bathroom first.
That careless detour was the only reason I did not walk into slaughter.
Stepping back out, I felt cold dampness on my bare feet.
Dark streaks trailed across the hallway carpet toward my door.
Panicked, I bolted into my bedroom and threw myself beneath my sheets, praying it was only a nightmare.
Minutes later, my bedroom hinges groaned in the silence.
Peeking from under my blanket, I saw a tall, hairless entity with pale leathery skin and hollow, eyeless sockets.
It was dragging my parents through the doorway.
With calm, horrifying precision, it propped my father against the foot of my bed, facing me.
Then it seated my mother in my desk chair, her mouth wide open in the shadows.
Next, the creature dipped its clawed hands into dark fluid on the floor.
It smeared ritualistic shapes across my bedroom walls, and gouged a line of words into the plaster above my desk.
When it finished, it slithered beneath my bed like a spider.
I felt the wooden slats beneath my mattress sag under its weight.
It has been down there for three hours, waiting for me to wake up.
Now, pre-dawn light is creeping through my window.
My eyes have adjusted to the gloom, and I can finally read the carved message on the wall.
Four simple words: I know you are awake.
Inspired by the creepypasta I Know You're Awake.
Would you have looked under the bed?
